title: Leadership, collaborators & support
overview: AI for Laboratory Operations is a unified ecosystem of AI tools that transforms raw data into actionable, evidence-backed intelligence in support of ORNL Operations and associated stakeholders.
leadership: Led by Principal Investigator Dr. Tirthankar Ghosal (Staff Scientist), the research and development team includes Dr. Sanjay Das (Postdoctoral Researcher; lead R&D personnel), Dr. Ran Edgeway (PhD GRO intern), and Dr. Ethan Seefried (Postdoctoral Researcher), from the Learning Systems group, Computer Science and Mathematics Division (CSMD), Computing and Computational Sciences Directorate (CCSD).
operations: Integral collaborators from ORNL Operations include Ryan Burchfield, Lauren Deck, Alan Guy, Gavin Wiggins, and 25+ subject-matter experts across ORNL Operations divisions.
engineering: A software team from ITSD supports the AI team in making the tools enterprise-ready. PI Ghosal holds regular one-to-one meetings with ITSD and Operations leadership to coordinate tool progress and launch.

symposia.title: 2nd AI4Ops Symposium
symposia.body: PI Ghosal and ITSD colleagues presented and demonstrated in-progress tools at the 2nd AI4Ops Symposium, organized by LANL in Santa Fe.

symposia.title: 3rd AI4Ops Symposium
symposia.body: ORNL will organize the third AI4Ops Symposium in 2027.

sailor.name: SAILOR
sailor.expansion: Smart AI for Laboratory Operations and Reconnaissance
sailor.body: PI Ghosal is working with Chief Operating Officers from ORNL, PNNL, SRNL, and INL to extend this initiative across the DOE ecosystem through a Community of Practice and a Consortium of Battelle Laboratories.
sailor.status: Community and consortium development in progress
